cases.sentence: ___ людей была для них дороже одобрения Бога.
cases.translation: The praise of men was dearer to them than the approval of God.
cases.explain: Похвала is the grammatical subject of была, so it is nominative.

cases.sentence: Похвала людей была для них дороже одобрения ___.
cases.translation: The praise of men was dearer to them than the approval of God.
cases.explain: The noun одобрение governs a genitive complement: approval of God.

cases.sentence: Они подошли к ___, ученику Иисуса, который был родом из Вифсаиды в Галилее.
cases.translation: They came to Philip, a disciple of Jesus who was from Bethsaida in Galilee.
cases.explain: The preposition к governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Мария в это время взяла ___ чистого нардового масла, которое стоило очень дорого.
cases.translation: Mary at that time took a jar of pure nard oil, which was very costly.
cases.explain: The transitive verb взять takes a direct object; for inanimate masculine nouns the accusative matches the nominative.

cases.translation: The whole house was filled with the fragrance of the oil.
cases.explain: The verb наполниться (to be filled with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Но кто возненавидит свою жизнь в этом ___, тот сохранит ее для вечной жизни.
cases.translation: But whoever hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Мария в это время взяла кувшин чистого нардового масла, которое стоило очень дорого, и вылила его на ноги Иисусу.
reading.question: What did Mary do with the expensive perfume?
options: She poured it on Jesus's feet
She sold it to give money to the poor
reading.correct: She poured it on Jesus's feet
reading.explain: Mary took a jar of costly pure nard and poured it on Jesus's feet.

reading.ru: Иуда Искариот, один из учеников Иисуса, который впоследствии предал его, возмутился.
reading.question: Who objected to Mary's use of the expensive perfume?
reading.explain: Judas Iscariot, one of Jesus's disciples who would later betray him, objected.

reading.ru: Он говорил это не потому, что заботился о нищих, а потому что был вор.
reading.question: Why, according to the text, did Judas really object?
options: Because he was a thief who stole from the money box
Because he genuinely cared for the poor
Because he was jealous of Lazarus
reading.correct: Because he was a thief who stole from the money box
reading.explain: The text explains he said this not because he cared for the poor but because he was a thief.

reading.ru: «Оставь ее», — сказал Иисус. «Она должна была сохранить этот бальзам на день моего погребения.
reading.question: What did Jesus say Mary's perfume was meant for?
reading.explain: Jesus said she was to keep it for the day of his burial.

reading.ru: Первосвященники же решили убить и Лазаря, потому что из-за него многие иудеи приходили к Иисусу и верили в Него.
reading.question: Why did the chief priests decide to kill Lazarus too?
options: Because many Jews were believing in Jesus because of him
Because Lazarus had betrayed the priests
reading.correct: Because many Jews were believing in Jesus because of him
reading.explain: Many Jews were going to Jesus and believing in him because of Lazarus.

reading.ru: Люди взяли пальмовые ветви и вышли Ему навстречу с возгласами.
reading.question: What did the crowd do as Jesus entered Jerusalem?
options: They took palm branches and went out to meet him with shouts
reading.correct: They took palm branches and went out to meet him with shouts
reading.explain: The crowd took palm branches and went out to meet him, shouting.

reading.ru: Иисус нашел молодого осла и сел на него, как об этом и написано.
reading.question: What did Jesus ride into Jerusalem, fulfilling what was written?
reading.explain: Jesus found a young donkey and sat on it, as it was written.

reading.ru: Фарисеи с досадой говорили друг другу, «Ничего не помогает, весь мир идет за ним».
reading.question: What did the frustrated Pharisees say to each other?
options: That the whole world was going after Jesus
That they should arrest him at once
That the feast should be canceled
reading.correct: That the whole world was going after Jesus
reading.explain: The Pharisees said in frustration, 'Nothing is working; the whole world has gone after him.'

reading.ru: Они подошли к Филиппу, ученику Иисуса, который был родом из Вифсаиды в Галилее, и попросили. «Господин, мы бы хотели увидеть Иисуса».
reading.question: What did the Greeks ask Philip?
reading.explain: The Greeks came to Philip and said, 'Sir, we would like to see Jesus.'

reading.ru: Если пшеничное зерно не упадет в землю и не умрет, то оно останется одним зерном.
reading.question: What image does Jesus use to explain his coming death?
options: A grain of wheat that must die to bear fruit
A vine that must be pruned
A lamp that must be lit
reading.correct: A grain of wheat that must die to bear fruit
reading.explain: Jesus compares his death to a grain of wheat that must fall and die to produce many seeds.

reading.ru: И с небес раздался голос «Прославил и еще прославлю».
reading.question: What happened after Jesus prayed, 'Father, glorify your name'?
options: Angels appeared visibly to the crowd
reading.explain: A voice came from heaven saying, 'I have glorified it, and will glorify it again.'

reading.ru: Ходите, пока есть свет, чтобы вас не покрыла тьма.
reading.question: What did Jesus urge the people to do while they had the light?
options: Walk while they have the light, so darkness would not overtake them
reading.correct: Walk while they have the light, so darkness would not overtake them
reading.explain: Jesus told them to walk while they have the light, so that darkness would not overtake them.

reading.ru: Даже после того, как Иисус сотворил перед ними столько знамений, они не верили в Него.
reading.question: What was surprising about the people's response despite Jesus's many signs?
options: They still did not believe in him
They made him king at once
They stoned him for the signs
reading.correct: They still did not believe in him
reading.explain: Even after so many signs, the people still did not believe in Jesus.

reading.ru: Впрочем, даже среди начальников многие поверили в Иисуса. Хотя из боязни перед фарисеями и перед тем, что их отлучат от синагоги, они не говорили о своей вере.
reading.question: What did many of the Jewish rulers do about their belief in Jesus?
options: They believed but kept it secret for fear of being expelled from the synagogue
They resigned their positions in protest
They reported Jesus to Pilate immediately
reading.correct: They believed but kept it secret for fear of being expelled from the synagogue
reading.explain: Many rulers believed in Jesus but did not confess it for fear of the Pharisees and being put out of the synagogue.
